item.title: Push to raise the minimum wage in Alabama
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) — Alabama could soon have its own legally mandated minimum wage. The measure would replace the current $7.25 federal minimum wage, if passed by the state legislature. The Senate bill would set the state minimum wage at $10 an hour, while also creating exemptions for small businesses with 50 or fewer employees. [...]
